source: assets/template/Business Process Agentification (Session 4).pptx (slides 3, 5, 13, 17, 24) — all 5 chapter dividers use the same 3-shape pattern
intent: Reset deck rhythm at the start of a new chapter / section. Provides a visual breath between content-dense slides and signals a topic transition.
invariants: right half of the slide is a full-bleed accent panel (no text on it)
left half has exactly two text blocks: section number and section title, stacked vertically
section number uses the display type style and the same accent color as the right panel
section title uses the title type style and text_primary color
no header bar, no body content, no bullets — the slide is itself the heading
an optional thin secondary accent strip runs along the bottom of the left half
variables: section title text (3-7 words, claim-style or topic-style both acceptable)
right-panel accent color (any palette accent — choose to mark the section's color identity)
secondary accent strip color (typically a contrasting palette accent or omit entirely)
presence of editorial image on the right panel (in a hosted deck, the panel would carry an image; the example uses a flat fill as a stand-in)
